sanskrit_verse: मन्त्रौषधिबलात् किंचित् संभ्रान्तिं दर्शयन्ति ये / मूलकर्म च कुर्वन्ति निर्वास्यास् ते महीभुजाः ।।
transliteration: mantrauṣadhibalāt kiñcit saṃbhraāntiṃ darśayanti ye / mūlakarma ca kurvanti nirvāsyās te mahībhujāḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: Those rulers who, through the power of mantras and medicinal substances, cause even slight disturbance or confusion in the minds of beings and engage in foundational misdeeds shall be removed from their positions of authority.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is conditional upon the maintenance of mental and spiritual stability among subjects.
Misuse of esoteric knowledge or substances constitutes a breach of sovereign capacity.
Leaders bear responsibility for the consciousness-field impact of their actions.
Restoration requires removal from influence when foundational misconduct occurs.
Consciousness alignment demands that governance arise from unshaken inner stillness.
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler uses mantra/medicine to disturb collective consciousness THEN remove from office.
IF root action disrupts societal dharma THEN invalidate authority status.
IF evidence shows induced confusion via occult means THEN initiate capacity-review protocol.
IF leader fails to uphold consciousness clarity THEN trigger replacement mechanism.
IF foundational karma impacts sovereignty THEN enforce cessation of ruling function.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes a threshold where misuse of tantric or medicinal powers by state actors constitutes automatic disqualification from holding executive or judicial office. The court must assess not only overt acts but also subtle energetic disturbances caused by such practices, applying pramana-based investigation into causal effects on public consciousness.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This law aligns with Nyaya through direct perception (pratyaksha) and inference (anumana) of causal disruption. It follows anupūrvaśaḥ as it traces effect back to root act. Responsibility is proportional to access and misuse of sacred instruments. Enforcement focuses on cessation and correction rather than infliction of pain, ensuring alignment with non-punitive reality.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate consciousness-clearing process for affected population.
Reassign leadership to one whose capacity remains undisturbed.
Restore energetic integrity of region through Vedic remediation.
Implement review system to prevent recurrence of occult misuse.
Facilitate completion process for displaced ruler to reclaim personal sovereignty.
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, source of all Dharma, this law stands executed. Authority derives solely from alignment with universal consciousness. Misconduct rooted in mantra or medicine breaches foundational duty. Removal restores balance without infliction. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth. Dharma is now established.
